annotations.description: Fires for each telemetry source present at any time in the last day and absent now. It was count by (source) (...) < 1, which could never fire: a lost source's series vanishes rather than reading 0, so the rule resolved at the moment it should have fired (C168). Limit: a source gone longer than a day stops firing; P.7 replaces this with the expected set from inventory.

annotations.description: Fires per DEVICE on a syslog message of severity 0-2 (emergencies, alerts, critical): IOS writes severity as the digit in the mnemonic. Severity 3 is not alerted: SMART_LIC-3-COMM_FAILED recurs by design (D4 gives the lab no route to Cisco). The device is the origin-id after the sequence number, as the heartbeat rules read it; the stream's host label is the collector. No data is the healthy state (C166, C168).
